1: // Cosmic Dodger – minimal implementation
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the page.
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const width = canvas.width;
8:   const height = canvas.height;
9: 
10:   // Ship definition
11:   const ship = {
12:     x: width / 2,
13:     y: height / 2,
14:     size: 12,
15:     speed: 3,
16:     dx: 0,
17:     dy: 0,
18:   };
19: 
20:   // Input handling
21:   const keys = {};
22:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
23:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
24: 
25:   // Asteroid pool
26:   const asteroids = [];
27:   const spawnInterval = 1500; // ms
28:   let lastSpawn = 0;
29:   let score = 0;
30:   let gameOver = false;
31: 
32:   function spawnAsteroid() {
33:     const edge = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4); // 0: top,1:right,2:bottom,3:left
34:     let x, y, vx, vy;
35:     const speed = 1 + Math.random() * 2;
36:     if (edge === 0) { // top
37:       x = Math.random() * width;
38:       y = -20;
39:       vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed;
40:       vy = speed;
41:     } else if (edge === 1) { // right
42:       x = width + 20;
43:       y = Math.random() * height;
44:       vx = -speed;
45:       vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed;
46:     } else if (edge === 2) { // bottom
47:       x = Math.random() * width;
48:       y = height + 20;
49:       vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed;
50:       vy = -speed;
51:     } else { // left
52:       x = -20;
53:       y = Math.random() * height;
54:       vx = speed;
55:       vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed;
56:     }
57:     const r = 8 + Math.random() * 12;
58:     asteroids.push({ x, y, vx, vy, r });
59:   }
60: 
61:   function update(dt) {
62:     // Ship movement
63:     ship.dx = ship.dy = 0;
64:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.dx = -ship.speed;
65:     if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.dx = ship.speed;
66:     if (keys.ArrowUp) ship.dy = -ship.speed;
67:     if (keys.ArrowDown) ship.dy = ship.speed;
68:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width, ship.x + ship.dx));
69:     ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(height, ship.y + ship.dy));
70: 
71:     // Spawn asteroids
72:     if (Date.now() - lastSpawn > spawnInterval) {
73:       spawnAsteroid();
74:       lastSpawn = Date.now();
75:     }
76: 
77:     // Move asteroids and remove off‑screen ones
78:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
79:       const a = asteroids[i];
80:       a.x += a.vx;
81:       a.y += a.vy;
82:       if (a.x < -30 || a.x > width + 30 || a.y < -30 || a.y > height + 30) {
83:         asteroids.splice(i, 1);
84:         score++;
85:       } else if (Math.hypot(a.x - ship.x, a.y - ship.y) < a.r + ship.size) {
86:         gameOver = true;
87:       }
88:     }
89:   }
90: 
91:   function draw() {
92:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
93:     // Ship – simple triangle
94:     ctx.fillStyle = 'cyan';
95:     ctx.beginPath();
96:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y - ship.size);
97:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x - ship.size, ship.y + ship.size);
98:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.size, ship.y + ship.size);
99:     ctx.closePath();
100:     ctx.fill();
101:     // Asteroids – circles
102:     ctx.fillStyle = 'gray';
103:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
104:       ctx.beginPath();
105:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
106:       ctx.fill();
107:     });
108:     // Score
109:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
110:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
111:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
112:     // Game over overlay
113:     if (gameOver) {
114:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
115:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
116:       ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
117:       ctx.font = '32px sans-serif';
118:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
119:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
120:     }
121:   }
122: 
123:   let lastTime = 0;
124:   function loop(timestamp) {
125:     if (!lastTime) lastTime = timestamp;
126:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
127:     lastTime = timestamp;
128:     if (!gameOver) update(dt);
129:     draw();
130:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
131:   }
132:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
133: })();
